title: Just A Cold Spot, Not Ghosts

sentences.text: Hmph. The alleged haunting is probably just a simple thermal anomaly in the living room.
From 04:20 to 06:00, the temperature was observed at 18.4 °C, which is significantly below the expected range of 19.3 °C to 20.0 °C.
This cold spot most likely indicates a draft or an open window, rather than any supernatural activity.
I suggest checking the thermostat and ensuring all windows are properly sealed to prevent such dips in temperature.
